intro: Over the past month, ZCyberNews has tracked 35 articles on credential theft, with AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit among the top threat actors observed. The coverage spans from April 12 to May 12, 2026, and highlights vulnerabilities including CVE-2021-47928 (CVSS 8.2), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, and CVE-2025-9501. Affected sectors include technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and social media, with impacts reported globally across Europe, North America, Bangladesh, and South Asia. The severity mix comprises 27 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational reports.
